excerpt: Ogment's @O is an AI coworker you tag in Slack. Launched as a general assistant, it is now pitched to Swiss fiduciaries for bookkeeping, VAT, closing and payroll work. What it does and alternatives.
content:
Ogment makes @O, an AI agent that lives in Slack. You tag @O in a channel like a colleague and ask it in plain English to do something, such as create a CRM record, update a Salesforce deal or file a Linear ticket. At its Product Hunt launch Ogment said @O connects to more than 1,000 tools, can run automations on a schedule, and shares memory and skills across the whole team, with a one-click Slack install.

Since then, Ogment's website has narrowed its pitch to Swiss fiduciaries (accounting and trust firms). There, @O takes the first pass on bookkeeping and bank reconciliation, flags missing receipts and drafts reminders to clients, proposes entries with VAT codes, and prepares close, tax, VAT, audit and payroll files for a person to approve. Files can be imported into Swiss accounting tools such as WinBiz, Abacus and Bexio. The site is in English, German and French, describes the software as Swiss-built and SOC 2 compliant, and offers a free 30-minute AI audit instead of public prices.

The Slack launch of Ogment AI was on 7 July 2026 and finished #9 for the day, with 154 upvotes and 117 comments (as of 14 October 2026). It was Ogment's second launch on Product Hunt.

We have not tested Ogment ourselves. This page brings together its official site and its Product Hunt page, and says where each fact comes from.

profile.category: AI agent for Slack / accounting automation
profile.summary_short: AI coworker you tag in Slack, now focused on accounting workflows for Swiss fiduciaries

gallery.alt: Ogment '1-click install for Slack': a user tags @O in a sales channel to create a CRM record
Ogment '1,000+ integrations' graphic with Gmail, Notion, Salesforce, Linear and Google Calendar icons
Ogment 'Delegate tasks to O' showing @O creating a Linear ticket, updating Salesforce and checking client files in Slack

use_cases: Tagging @O in Slack to update a CRM record or file a ticket
Reconciling bank statements against invoices and receipts for a client file
Drafting reminders to clients for missing documents
Preparing VAT, month-end close, tax and audit packs for review
Checking payroll changes against signed documents

fit: run a Swiss fiduciary or accounting firm that works in Slack
want an agent to take the first pass on bookkeeping while staff approve every entry
not_fit: want a general-purpose Slack assistant with public pricing: the site now focuses on fiduciaries and sells through an AI audit call
use Microsoft Teams rather than Slack
need to know the price before talking to sales

pricing.intro: Ogment does not publish prices. Its site offers a free 30-minute AI audit of where a firm's hours go, with an AI ROI plan.

pros: Works inside Slack, so there is no new app to learn
Proposes entries and drafts messages but leaves approval to your team, according to Ogment
Swiss accounting formats and tools (CAMT bank files, WinBiz, Abacus, Bexio)
Site available in English, German and French
cons: Positioning has narrowed since launch, so general Slack users may not be the focus

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as alternatives to @O. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: viktor.com
items.what: AI employee that does the work in Slack and Teams
items.difference: A general AI employee for Slack and Teams; Ogment now targets fiduciary accounting work.

items.name: Runbear
items.what: Build AI teammates to automate workflows in Slack and Teams
items.difference: You build your own agents; @O comes with accounting workflows set up.

items.name: Zapier
items.difference: Rule-based automations you configure; @O takes requests in plain English inside Slack.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Slack itself and Adapt.

x.none: We found no posts about Ogment on X to link yet.

faq.a: An AI agent that lives in Slack. You tag @O and ask it to do tasks across your tools. Ogment's site now focuses on accounting work for Swiss fiduciaries.
Ogment does not publish prices. It offers a free 30-minute AI audit.

According to Ogment: data entry and bank reconciliation, missing-receipt reminders, proposed entries with VAT, month-end close, tax and VAT packs, audit preparation and payroll checks, each routed to your team to approve.

faq.q: Which accounting software does it work with?
faq.a: Ogment's site names WinBiz, Abacus and Bexio as import targets, and bank exports in CAMT, CSV and PDF.
